A '''Force punch''' was an application of the Force where the user would [[Enhance Attribute|augment]] their striking strength, in the form of a punch or blow in close hand to hand combat. [[Vestara Khai]] while fighting the [[Enara Massar|red-haired female assistant]] of [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Ivaar Workan]]; grabbed her by the chin and used a Force punch to the throat to kill her in [[44 ABY]], and later [[Saba Sebatyne]] delivered a Force-enhanced double punch to an avatar of [[Abeloth]], striking her in the mouth and through both sets of her fangs shortly before killing her.<ref>''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref> [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] was a master of this ability, using lightning fast jabs to decimate an army of [[Battle droid/Legends|Battle droids]] during the [[Battle of Dantooine (Clone Wars)|Battle of Dantooine]],<ref name="CW12">{{CW|12}}</ref> and punching apart war robots while [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|defending Coruscant]].<ref>{{CW|23}}</ref> [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] during his [[Attack on the Lodge of the Canted Circle|fight]] against [[Maladian]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] used Force-enhanced blows to snap necks, smash skulls and windpipes, and plunge his fists through armored torsos in blinding motion.<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

[[Cade Skywalker]] used this power in 138 ABY against a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] thug.<ref name="Legacy 43">[[Legacy (2006) 43|''Legacy'' (2006) 43]]</ref>
